text: Visitor reviews over the last 30 days indicate issues with the food quality and menu options at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several guests found the salads either lacking flavor or having unusual combinations, and the venison chili was described as bland. There were also complaints about the limited menu range and the absence of basic service items like cups for water. Additionally, some visitors felt the food was overpriced given the portion sizes. These concerns suggest a need to review and improve the food offerings and service amenities.

windows.90: Over the last 90 days, visitor reviews have highlighted concerns about the food quality and menu options at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several guests found the food bland or poorly prepared, with specific mentions of salads lacking flavor and some dishes being described as minimal or overpriced. The menu was also criticized for being limited and not meeting expectations, with few choices and some items not matching their descriptions. Service and wait times were noted in a few reviews but were less frequently mentioned. Overall, the average rating was below 4, indicating room for improvement, especially in the food offerings.
